about: Today's Sky Devotion for La Porte, Indiana, picked each morning by what the sky is doing (devotion/sky.js). By La Porte Weather Now. Scripture: KJV (public domain). Weather: National Weather Service.
forecastLine: Columbus Day: Patchy Fog then Mostly Sunny, high near 84°. Monday Night: Mostly Clear, low around 69°.

entry.kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
entry.text: Fog shows how little we can see at a time, and Paul says that's true of life, too. We know in part, but God knows us fully. Drive slow, keep your low beams on, and trust Him with what you can't see yet.
